name: Mule
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 10. No listed skills, special senses, or languages.
appearance: A brown mule with long donkey-like ears, a short dark mane, a gray muzzle, and narrow hooves.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules, Version 1.0 (November 2018), p. 145.
sections.Traits:
Beast of Burden. Treat the mule as Large when calculating its carrying capacity.
Sure-Footed. The mule has advantage on Strength or Dexterity saves against an effect that would knock it prone.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage on a hit.

name: Tiger
otherStatistics: Perception +3 and Stealth +6. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages.
appearance: A muscular striped cat with an ochre coat, ivory cheeks, rounded ears, heavy forepaws, and a long tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules, Version 1.0 (November 2018), p. 156.
sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. Use advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.
Pounce. After moving straight toward a creature for at least 20 ft., the tiger forces a DC 13 Strength saving throw if it hits that creature with Claw on the same turn. The creature falls prone on a failure. If that target is prone, the tiger can make one Bite against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage on a hit.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage on a hit.
